rows.grounds: exact token evameva; indeclinable repeated adverb
exact token jagatsarvaṃ; accusative object of meditation
exact token dagdhaṃ; accusative participle modifying world-all
exact token dhyātvā; absolutive from dhyā
exact token vikalpitaḥ; nominative participle, subject or result

items.question: How does meditation on the burned world function?
premises: whole world is meditated as burned
meditation is performed in this manner
items.inference: meditation on the burned world yields an imagined state
uncertainties: syntactic role of vikalpitaḥ remains ambiguous
whether vikalpitaḥ names practitioner or world
items.plain_english: Having meditated thus on the entire world as burned, it is imagined.
